content.name: ask

arguments.i: Asking the owner the decisions needed before the build starts
arguments.html:
Before enyo-ui starts building from iteration 5, five choices. My recommendation is preselected.

Where to build

lenscale.ai is public today (the 1 Nov landing). preview.lenscale.ai already sits behind Cloudflare Zero Trust with Jerry, Nicola and @lenscale.ai allowed.

Who may see it

The other lenscale apps (admin, preview, app) also allow Nicola's Gmail (nicola@example.com).

What first
Open picks in iteration 5 (logo 8 provisional, 4 pricing titles, 3 demo question sets)
Where 'Book a demo' requests go

answers.name: where
answers.question: lenscale.ai is public today (the 1 Nov landing). preview.lenscale.ai already sits behind Cloudflare Zero Trust with Jerry, Nicola and @lenscale.ai allowed.
answers.answer: preview.lenscale.ai: already hidden, no Cloudflare change; lenscale.ai keeps the current landing until you say launch

answers.name: who
answers.question: The other lenscale apps (admin, preview, app) also allow Nicola's Gmail (nicola@example.com).
answers.answer: Same as the others: your Gmail, Nicola's Gmail, any @lenscale.ai address

answers.name: scope
answers.question: What first
answers.answer: The public site (pages 01–13) first; the app pages (14–24) next, restyling app.lenscale.ai

answers.name: picks
answers.question: Open picks in iteration 5 (logo 8 provisional, 4 pricing titles, 3 demo question sets)
answers.answer: Use logo 8, the first pricing title and question set 1 as provisional; change any time

answers.name: form
answers.question: Where 'Book a demo' requests go
answers.answer: Email to an @lenscale.ai inbox (write which in Other)
